tool_args.rationale: The target tolerance is tight and the observed response changes sharply across gradient regimes. A fine trajectory batch is justified to distinguish a smooth gradient effect from a localized high-gradient transition before committing to a numerical model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth base-field plus sink-gradient model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The seven rows show strong gradient dependence, but only one observation at each of the two off-baseline gradients leaves the interaction and possible onset of high-gradient suppression poorly identified.
The existing branch probe already includes both a low-gradient point and a near-threshold high-gradient point; another such contrast is less informative than a denser trajectory.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the target-law ambiguity.
